author: MysticDoeszPvp
body:
IGN (in game name)*: MysticDoeszPvp

What is the reason of your ban or mute?*: The staff said i was Using "AimBot"

If applicable, what modifications or hacks were you using and have you removed them?*: I did not use hacks before and i am just really good at sniping people. As i have been playing minecraft for a few years now. I am good with the bow. So i did not use hacks and i have not have anything to do with the modifications or hacks i were using.

Have you been banned from Avicus before?*: No i have not been this was my only time that i have been banned. Also i was banned by TheRomanTrident On November 11 2014/Also he was a gold donor rank too idk how he banned me :P.

Why should we unban or unmute you?*:I think that you should unban me because i wasn't using any kinda hacks and if i did i would learn my lesson by now. It has been nearly  2 years since i been on the server, i have not used any hacks. I believe this is a error and i would like to have my ban lift from me. I am not lying, also idk but they did not ss me :(. 


Thanks for reading my Appeal as i am hopefully to get unbanned and will meet you on the server
-Mystic <3 :D
